goodbye.h2: We are sorry to see you go 😢
goodbye.p: However, you are more than welcome to join again anytime and/or leave us with some feedback so we can improve.

delete-form.warning: CAUTION: You will need to confirm this action with your password, as this action is irreversible.
delete-form.label: Password

forgot-form.label: Email
forgot-form.description: We will send you an email in order to proceed with the password reset process. If you don't see the email in your inbox, please wait a few minutes or check your spam folder.

signup-form.name: Name
signup-form.pwd-description: We highly recommend using your Password Manager suggestion to create a strong password. This way, your password will be securely stored and you'll be able to use it without the need to memorize it!
signup-form.legal-description: By completing the sign up process and/or signing in with an external provider, you agree with our Terms & Conditions.
